paite: Huan ni bangzah hiam nung in Kapernaum a ahong lut nawnleh inn ah a-om chih thu ahong thang hi.
heading: Mizaw Hihdamna / (Mat 9.1-8; Luk 5.17-26)
english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

paite: Huchi in kongkhak kim a omna ding om lou khop in mi tampi ahong kikhawm ua, akiang uah thu agen hi.
english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

paite: Mizaw khat, mi li zawn, akiang ah ahon pi uhi.
english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

paite: Mipi ziak a akiangnai a ahong pai theih louh ziak un a-omna intung aphenvang ua; huai khit in alupna leh atung a mizaw lum kawm in akhaikhesuk uhi.
english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n aginna uh amuh in, mizaw kiang ah, "Ka tapa, na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

paite: Laigelhmi khenkhat huai mun ah atu uhi.
english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

paite: "Hiai mi'n bangziak a hichibang thu gen ahia? Pathian agensia hi; mi khat, Pathian kia lou ngal, kua'n ahia khelhnate ngaidam thei?" chi in alungtang un angaihtuah uhi.
english: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n, alungtang un huchibang angaihtuah uh chih alungsim in athei pah a, akiang uah, "Huai thu bangziak a na lungtang ua ngaihtuah na hi ua?
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

paite: Mizaw kiang a, 'Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita,' chih leh 'na lupna la inla, khe in paita in,' chih akoi ahia agen nuamzaw?
english: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

paite: Himahleh leitung ah Mihing Tapa in khelhnate ngaihdam theihna anei chih na theihna ding un," ahi, mizaw kiang ah;
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

paite: "Thou inla, na lupna la inla, na inn ah pai in, ka hon chi," achi hi.
english: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

paite: Huchi in amah athou a, alupna la pah in, avek ua mitmuh in apaita hi; huchi in avek un lamdang asa mahmah uh, hichibang himhim i mu ngei kei, chi in Pathian aphat uhi.
english: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

paite: Huan apawt nawn a tuipi gei ah apaita hi, mipi tengteng akiang ah ava pai ua, ama'n thu ana hilh hi.
heading: Levi Sapna / (Mat 9.9-13; Luk 5.27-32)
english: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

paite: Apai kawm in, Alphai tapa, Levi siah piakna mun a tu amu a, akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi. Athou a azuita hi.
english: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n Levi inn ah an a-um a, siahkhonte leh mikhialte tampi in Jesu leh anungzuite a-umpih uhi, amah zuite tampi ahi uh.
english: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

paite: Pharisaite leh laigelhmite'n Jesu'n mikhialte leh siahkhonte kiang a anek amuh un, anungzuite kiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia siahkhonte leh mikhialte kiang a anek a adawn?" achi uhi.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

paite: Jesu'n huai aza a, akiang uah, "Michidamte'n daktor akiphamoh kei ua, midamloute'n akiphamohzaw uh; midiktatte sam ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, mikhialte sam ding a hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

paite: Huan Johan nungzuite leh Pharisaite'n an angawl zel uhi. Amau ahong pai ua, Jesu kiang ah, "Bangziak a Johan nungzuite leh Pharisaite nungzuite'n an ngawl ua, nang nungzuite'n angolh sam louh uh?" achi uhi.
heading: An Ngawl Thu A Dotna / (Mat 9.14-17; Luk 5.33-39)
english: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Moupite kiang a apasal a-om lai teng moupite'n an angawl thei ua hia? Apasal ding akiang ua a-om lai teng angawl thei kei ding uh.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

paite: Himahleh akiang ua kipan apasal pimang nite ahong tung ding a, huai ni chiang in zaw angawl ding uhi.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

paite: "Kuamah in puan tui khai nai louh them in puan lui athuap ngei kei uh; thuap le uh, thuap bit asawmna lam uah akaikek ding a, athak in alui akaikek ding a, ahong kek semsem ding hi.
english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

paite: Huan kuamah in savun uain thawl lui ah uain thak athun ngei kei, uain in savun thawl aphukham ding a, uain abo bei ding hi, savun thawl mah leng; uain thak savun uain thawl thak ah athun zaw uh," achi hi.
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu Sabbath ni in buhlei ah apaisuak hi, anungzuite'n apai kawm un buhvuite akhiak uhi.
heading: Sabbath Thu A Dotna / (Mat 12.1-8; Luk 6.1-5)
english: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

paite: Pharisaite'n akiang ah, "En dih, bangziak a Sabbath ni a hihsiang lou hih ahi ua?" achi uhi.
english: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "David leh alawmte ataksap ua, agilkial lai ua athilhih uh na sim kei ua hia?
english: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

paite: Abiathar siampu lianpen ahih lai a, Pathian inn a alut a, siampute kia lou ngal in anek siang louh tanghou koihtuam anek a, alawmte kiang a apiak sam thu,” achi hi.
english: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

paite: Huan amah mah in, akiang uah, "Sabbath zaw mihing a dia bawl ahi, mihing bel Sabbath ni a dia bawl ahi kei hi.
english: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

paite: Huchi in Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath tung nangawn a Toupa ahi," achi hi.
english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”
